title.narrative: Greenhouse gs emissions reduction (Khujand SW Phase II). 140869

description.narrative: Greenhouse gs emissions reduction (Khujand SW Phase II). 140869

comment.narrative: Note that the referred gure represents the total number of kilotonnes being avoided by baseline year 2016 as a results of the implementation of the Khujand Solid Waste Management Project Phase I signed in November 2011 and close to being completed by the time this intervention was signed into force dec2017.

That is after the intervention a total of 5216 CO2 kilotonnes are expected to be reduced emissions avoided thus representing the total estimated for Phases I II of the subproject Khujand SW. Minus the Baseline value 1517 kilotonnes.
